```{r}
library(tidyverse)
rosmap_results = read_csv("human_neuron_rosmap_dreamlet_results.csv")
selected_results = rosmap_results %>% filter(ID %in% c("TGFB2","RHBDL3","MYO16","BMPER") &  assay == "medial mammillary neuron" )
write_csv(selected_results,"rosmap_results_selected_degs.csv")
```
